info.description: One of the page's statement sections — a small label, a heading, an optional quotation and one or more paragraphs beside a photograph. ⚠ WHAT IS NOT HERE: the section's number, its washes and grids, its float ornaments, the reveal delays and the order it appears in. Those are the design and stay in the page.

headingEm.description: The second half of the heading, set in italic. Leave empty for a heading that is all one weight.

quoteAuthor.description: Leave empty to credit the Principal named in Site Settings.

caption.description: Optional credit under the photograph — who is in it, or where it was taken.

captionSecond.description: The second line of that credit. The page sets it smaller.
